items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Bill Stapleton, with Woody Herman’s band, he did that, he stole that from Thad too.

ctx.x: Yeah I stole that from Thad Jones. Yeah Thad would always couple the flugelhorn with the lead alto and/or if the lead melody line in the saxes is a soprano sax, which is a very weak instrument, then he would couple the flugelhorn with the soprano in the melody and

it worked very well. Bill Stapleton, with Woody Herman’s band, he did that, he stole that from Thad too. We all stole from each other. But it’s interesting that if you couple things correctly, and it was a compliment you just paid me, that you can’t tell what it is, you just hear — it’s in there. You know.
Yeah. It’s a unique sound for that time. You must have transitioned, well I should say and ask, do you now use software, Finale or Sibelius or whatever?
